$comment: How words are WRITTEN to the voice so every engine says them right (job natural-voice, owner 28 Oct: 'Kannada' came out as 'Canada' for every voice). The text is respelled before it reaches an engine; subtitles and the chat keep the real spelling. Whole Latin-script words only, any case, longest first. `words` apply to every engine; `engines.<engine>` entries win for that engine only (Cartesia reads its own phoneme syntax <<ˈ|k|ʌ|...>>, which Bulbul would read aloud). An entry is listed only when the speech recogniser (scripts/pronunciation_check.py) agrees with it on a real voice; the recogniser is a proxy for a listener, not a replacement. Each workspace can add its own business and area names on top (Pronunciations.with_extra), and those win over everything here.
